label: Ever had loss of consciousness or admission to hospital following a head injury, or have you ever had a skull fracture? - Insight46 phase 1
meta_rows: Ever had loss of consciousness or admission to hospital following a head injury, or have you ever had a skull fracture? - Insight46 phase 1
Insight46 phase 1 participant history (self-reported) of head injury. Also collected at phase 2 - see library file I46P2_History.
cat_rows: This category contains data on the self-reported history of neurological disorder in parents and siblings of the participant in the Insight46 sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
